quotes.text: 501. LA SEMANA PASADA, DEL……...........… AL……..…., ¿TUVO UD. ALGÚN TRABAJO? (Sin contar los quehaceres del hogar)

assessments.reasoning: The supplied questionnaire documents do not ask whether a respondent supervises or remains available to care for children or other household members while doing other activities or without care being their main activity. Household tasks are explicitly excluded from work in question 501 ('Sin contar los quehaceres del hogar'), and domestic chores in question 211A are captured without any query regarding passive care, supervision, or availability for care. Care provided as a reason for not working does not satisfy the indicator.
